**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **Direction check:** No provision anywhere requires Meridian (Customer) to give Copperleaf (Vendor) terms no less favourable than those offered to third parties, or to match third-party offers. Targeted searches for "most favoured", "favourable/favorable", "MFN", and "no less" returned nothing beyond § 12.3.
- **Pricing sections reviewed:** § 7.1 (Fees fixed during initial term; no undisclosed charges) and § 8.3 (renewal uplift capped at lesser of CPI and 3%) both run in our favour and create no MFN mechanic.
- **Affirmative comfort:** § 12.3 expressly records that Customer "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position, so nothing to change.
